obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, icon strokes, hairline borders across the system — the workhorse dark that replaces pure black for a slightly warmer read

parchment.$description: Parchment — Page canvas, hero and footer backgrounds — warm off-white that signals editorial paper rather than digital default

gallery-white.$description: Gallery White — Card surfaces, image borders, badge backgrounds — the brighter neutral used to lift content off the parchment

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Headings, navigation borders, and high-contrast typographic moments where maximum weight is needed

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, card metadata, and list items — softer than Obsidian for secondary reading copy

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Muted heading accent and de-emphasized text — the quietest neutral, used for location subtitles and tertiary labels

charcoal-deep.$description: Charcoal Deep — Reserved for the heaviest display headlines where a hair more density than Ink Black is desired

gill-sans.$description: Primary typeface for all editorial copy and headings. The humanist warmth of Gill Sans is the signature — its slightly organic strokes and bookish personality carry the literary travel-magazine tone. 400 handles body and nav; 500 adds weight for sub-headings and card titles. The 64px/1.00 setting powers the monumental KOBU wordmark, where line-height matches font-size to let the letters bleed.

fira-mono.$description: Monospace for small uppercase labels — badges, navigation, and category tags. The fixed-width geometry and wide letter-spacing (0.167em–0.183em on 10–12px) read as printed museum tags, turning functional labels into typographic detail rather than UI chrome.

gill-sans-mt-pro.$description: Gill Sans MT Pro — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
